name: What are the most popular luxury features to include in a modern bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: What are the most popular luxury features to include in a modern bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Popular luxury features for modern bathroom remodels often include large format natural stone or porcelain tiles, walk-in showers with multiple showerheads or steam functions, freestanding soaking tubs, and custom-designed floating vanities. Other sought-after elements are integrated smart technology, radiant floor heating, advanced lighting systems, and high-efficiency, water-saving fixtures. These features enhance both aesthetics and functionality, creating a spa-like experience.
acceptedAnswer.description: Popular luxury features include large format stone, walk-in steam showers, freestanding tubs, smart technology, and radiant floor heating.
